name: alia-plugin-my-jira

alia.name: Jira Board
alia.description: Your Jira tickets, open and done: filter by status and type, search, group by status, initiative or epic, or board, and open a ticket beside the list. Change statuses in place, move with the keyboard. Sign in with Atlassian in the browser and pick your site if you have several; nothing to set up.
